from rdflib import Graph
g = Graph()
g.parse("/app/university_graph.ttl", format="turtle")

q = """
PREFIX uni: <http://university.org/ontology/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?dept (COUNT(DISTINCT ?student) AS ?cnt) WHERE {
  ?course uni:isTaughtIn ?dept .
  ?student uni:isEnrolledIn ?course .
  ?student uni:hasEnrollmentDate ?ed .
  FILTER(?ed <= "2025-08-16"^^xsd:date)
  OPTIONAL { ?student uni:hasGraduationDate ?gd . }
  FILTER(!BOUND(?gd) || ?gd > "2025-08-16"^^xsd:date)
} GROUP BY ?dept ORDER BY DESC(?cnt)
"""
for row in g.query(q):
    print(row.dept, row.cnt)
